facts.fact: The National Building Review Board says IRAS automated revenue collection and payment processes in 166 vote-level local governments, and is now the payment gateway for building fees; what it records of payers is not stated.
IRAS is in use in 166 vote-level local governments, according to the National Building Review Board; no total is given.
IRAS was developed by the Ministry of Local Government through the Local Government Finance Commission.
